title: Fraction Calculator
h1: Fraction Calculator — Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide
description: Add, subtract, multiply or divide two fractions and simplify the result. Mixed numbers are accepted, and the math runs in your browser.
intro: Enter two fractions as whole numbers or mixed values such as 1 1/2. Pick an operation to see the simplified result and the decimal form.
blurb: Add, subtract, multiply or divide fractions and simplify the result.
howItWorks: Enter each value as a proper fraction (3/4), a whole number (2) or a mixed number (1 1/2).
Choose add, subtract, multiply or divide.
Press Calculate to see the simplified fraction, a mixed number when it is greater than one, and the decimal.
examples: 2/4 simplifies to 1/2 before it is shown.

faq.q: How do I enter a mixed number?
faq.a: Use a space between the whole part and the fraction, such as 1 1/2. A slash is required in the fractional part.

faq.q: What happens on divide by zero?
faq.a: A zero denominator or a zero divisor is rejected with an error. The page does not return infinity.
Yes for rational inputs. The calculator uses integer arithmetic and reduces by the greatest common divisor.
